meta.description: Sends personalized 5-touch email sequences to HOT leads. Runs 3x/day (9h, 14h, 17h). Reads outreach-tracker sheet, finds leads due for next touch, personalizes via role+industry+Gemini, sends via Resend, logs back to tracker. TOUCH DELAYS: T1→T2: 3d, T2→T3: 4d, T3→T4: 5d, T4→T5: 7d. REQUIRES: RESEND_API_KEY + GEMINI_API_KEY + LEADS_SHEET_ID env vars in n8n + Google Sheets credential + outreach-tracker tab with columns: lead_email, first_name, last_name, company, job_title, industry, additional_info, linkedin_url, score, touch_sent, status_after, sent_at, next_send_at, enqueued_at
